demo.cliff: weight rolls up through the bag
teaches: A container holds nothing itself: the things inside it are ordinary Items on the same Actor, each naming this document's id in container.id.
onHand is the difference between a bag being carried and a bag being in the hold — it is what decides whether the contents count against encumbrance.
locked and lockedDescription hide the contents from a player without hiding the bag.
demo.trap: weightless on a container takes the bag out of the total with everything in it: getTotalWeight returns 0 before it reaches the contents. A bag of holding is exactly this flag, and a bag that weighs nothing around contents that still weigh cannot be expressed, because a container has no mass of its own to remove. The weight on the bag's own line reads the contents and ignores the flag, so that line can show a load the encumbrance total does not count.

system.description: A patrol satchel: oilcloth, two buckles and a shoulder strap that has been replaced twice.
